slug: 2026-01-20 Africa Pushes Back On US Health Deals Over Data, Power
note: Government-to-government health data sharing under a US agreement; not a rule on sending data abroad; Lesotho appears only in the list of signatories.
FOIA complaint over US health agreements and their data-sharing agreements; no rule on sending data abroad stated for Lesotho.

facts.fact: Z. Mayet and Associates says Lesotho's Data Protection Act (Act No. 5 of 2012) is the law in force and has SADC-model-inspired rules on cross-border data transfers, which it says need modern adequacy tools; no date given for the statement, so the 2025-10-31 publication date is used.

Z. Mayet and Associates says the Data Protection Commission and Commissioner have not been appointed, so no authority exists to approve cross-border mechanisms or issue guidance, and that standard contractual clauses and binding corporate rules are not yet in place; no date given for the statement, so the 2025-10-31 publication date is used.
